items.original_title: Dems More Motivated to Turn Out in Midterms Than Trump Base, Says Eli Yokley
items.rss_summary: Eli Yokley, politics analyst for Morning Consult, said that race ratings are turning away from Republicans because Democrats are more motivated to turn out to vote in the upcoming midterm elections than the Trump base. Yokley said Trump's approval rating has declined significantly in key states like Alaska and Kansas as war with Iran drags on.  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: We're Back to Normal Rates, Says Ed Yardeni
items.original_title: We're Back to Normal Rates, Says Ed Yardeni
items.rss_summary:
Yields in the US and other advanced economies have climbed to multidecade highs, tightening financial conditions, amid higher inflation triggered by the US-Iran war and concern about budget shortfalls. 
Traders have responded by paring rate-hike expectations, with the amount priced into swaps across eight major economies falling by almost 200 basis points since mid-September, according to data compiled by Bloomberg.
